questions.prompt: Who was included in the University of Pennsylvania study?
choices: Women ages 45 to 80 who used or did not use GLP-1 medications
Only cancer doctors at one hospital
questions.hintKo: The other choices describe groups that were not the study population.

questions.prompt: What lower risk was linked to GLP-1 medications in the study?
choices: A lower risk of catching a cold
A lower risk of breaking bones
A lower risk of developing breast cancer
A lower risk of needing glasses
questions.hintKo: The study was about breast cancer risk, not colds, bones, glasses, or allergies.

questions.prompt: Where did researchers collect the data for this observational study?
questions.hintKo: The researchers did not use school scores, weather data, recipes, or social media comments.

questions.prompt: Why is the study promising but not proof yet?
choices: Because the study was only about one person
Because the study was written in another language
Because the medicines are not real
Because it was observational and did not prove cause and effect
Because scientists already finished all clinical trials
questions.hintKo: The study was large and real, but clinical trials are still needed to prove the effect.

questions.prompt: How will researchers test this idea more carefully in the future?
questions.hintKo: Movie reviews, guesses, weather reports, or stopping research would not test a medical hypothesis.
